definitions.explanation: The area outside of buildings; the opposite of indoors.

notes:
{屋外|おくがい} means outdoors or outside, referring to the open air outside of buildings.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {屋外|おくがい}: outdoors, outside
- ⟦{屋内|おくない}→屋内：18948_okunai⟧: indoors, inside
- {屋外|おくがい}: outside (relative to buildings)
- ⟦{野外|やがい}→野外：17152_yagai⟧: outdoors, open field (nature-focused)
- ⟦{戸外|こがい}→戸外：28414_kogai⟧: outdoors (literary)
